comments.author: @surviveunplugged
comments.text: I've watched American business shift from "Value added" business models to extractive business models. I first observed it in the mid 90's within the banking industry as an Auditor at KPMG. Banks shifted from an "interest rate spread" model to a "fee based" and transactional model. Similar observation with the computer industry. From the purchase model, to perpetual pay or subscription model. Corporations are extracting (or squeezing) profit from existing offerings instead of providing new products or capabilities. They've also incorporated management tools to govern the workforce like machings to increase productivity. It's particularly bad with larger corporations. American small business isn't as bad, but the overall tone of American business has changed. I think it's a "stage of Empire" reality that will have to run its course.
